user.title: Fediverse Feed
user.description: Lemmy and Mastodon work without an account. Pixelfed servers need an access token: in Pixelfed open Settings → Applications → Personal access tokens, create one with the scope 'read' and paste it here. A Mastodon token is only needed for servers that hide their timelines.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Fediverse Feed is already set up. Use Configure to change the tokens.

init.title: Access tokens
init.description: Leave a token empty to use the server without an account.
